title: fix: completed recovery history blocks future updates
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes updates being blocked by completed recovery history from an older reader format or by unfinished cleanup of an obsolete package.

## User Impact

Completed history no longer prevents the next update. Unfinished restoration, unknown or corrupt records, and active mutations still require recovery; retained evidence is not deleted or rewritten.

This changes the installed updater. It cannot run inside an unchanged older updater that refuses before fetching the candidate.

## Why This Change Was Made

Admission needs to determine whether recovery is pending, not execute every historical record. Use the existing validated inspection codec for history and strict execution decoding only for the operation being acted on. Typed terminal package retirement is cleanup; unfinished restore progress remains blocking. Preserve the matching operation’s finalizer and prevent CLI fallback from completing over unrelated unfinished recovery.

This is complementary to [Scott’s package-publication repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167302) and [package receipt/cleanup repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167330), not a replacement for either.

## Evidence

- 165 unique focused tests across six recovery/CLI files passed, including regressions that fail with the original reader/predicate and the unfinished-recovery fallback.
- Both changed-file gate selections passed: types, lint, dead exports and repository guards.
- Independent P0–P1 autoreview found no actionable findings; maintainer source review also completed.
- Local single-worker Vitest: recovery plus terminal-record run 78.71 s total; CLI recovery 62.33 s and CLI siblings 51.68 s (Vitest durations). CI seconds not yet measured.

### Completed packed-candidate qualification (2026-10-08)

All five maintained Docker cells passed on their first attempt, with no timeout; final scheduler status is `passed` and cleanup joined. The parent independently reran `assertPackageRecoveryEvidence` on all five structured receipts.

| Released writer / scenario | Result | Cell time |
|---|---|---:|
| 2026.9.8 / publication interruption | Passed | 930 s |
| 2026.9.9 / publication interruption | Passed | 752 s |
| 2026.9.8 / post-publication Doctor failure | Passed | 827 s |
| 2026.9.9 / post-publication Doctor failure | Passed | 659 s |
| 2026.9.7 → unchanged 2026.9.8 / stranded first hop | Passed negative control | 322 s |

Positive cells used the exact composed candidate `1aa57206f693d5e2fbce607289d0bbeefbff32d1`, tarball SHA-256 `20f5375db04391e3155d1a1386843e8aeb80cade377193b71e7221e5b7d490f7`. This is a local qualification package labeled 2026.9.9, not a published release. Runtime owners match #167330 at `2c6986b123f8ce44bbeb9c714ab20a3515a73a30` and #167358 at `d3932c61a3517bb171d4c1242a2699897bae1ee8`.

Each authentic released writer created its own journal and helper and reached `publication-complete`. Installed-candidate public repair and repeated repair exited 0. Full retained-tree inventory, identity and original helper digest, unchanged candidate bytes, and authored settings were preserved. Every positive cell then installed the distinct expected package/build identity `2026.9.10-first-hop.0` through the updater, with retained evidence and settings still preserved. This supplies the requested shipped-writer compatibility/repair/next-update proof; focused unfinished-restoration refusal regressions remain separate supporting evidence.

The negative control confirms unchanged 9.8 blocks before staging/accessing the deliberately absent candidate: `update-recovery-pending`, `candidateCodeInvoked:false`. It does not claim candidate-only rescue of a stranded old updater. Old-reader → external-new-repair → old-reader remains uncovered, and no full release upgrade or release publication is claimed.

Frozen trusted harness: `ec0a4e67d8a3ae45e0311cb27a62f4e00b745820`. At final harness head `6c05dc5bfebacd61b25333d5b07a3a3913c52f80`, recovery-specific modules, policy and Docker planner remain byte-identical; shared main phase-logging/restart-fixture changes are covered by focused conflict tests, not claimed byte-identical. Aggregate cell time is 3,490 s (58m10s), excluding setup. These are local Docker measurements, not CI seconds.

Current-head required CI is green on all three PRs. Exact-head ClawSweeper reviews completed with no code findings; their outstanding qualification requests are addressed by these results. Existing independent source-review dispositions and the harness's inherited local Knip failure remain recorded, not relabeled as clean checks.
